verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents running payroll online, including in 'as little as 30 seconds' and with one-click handling of deposits and filings. Its Intelligent Pay Cycle flags issues before submission, and AI-suggested modifications help fix missing punches, which supports a review step. However, no evidence describes an ops-facing review of hours and earnings or a preview of payroll totals within the same flow; Pre-check is employee-side review, not an ops preview. Missing for 10: documented hours/earnings review screen, payroll totals preview before submit, an explicit single end-to-end flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: Run payroll in as little as 30 seconds with Paychex Flex®.
Intelligent Pay Cycle flags issues before they cause delays.
AI-suggested Modifications and employee self-service speed up fixes for missing punches.
In just one click, Paychex handles direct deposits, tax filings, and pay stubs/checks for your team.
